title: pm-daily-scratchpad-2026-03-13
content:
Maya's daily scratchpad - 2026-03-13

Top priorities for today:
- PRD edits (finalize metrics + rollout) — goal: have ready for review by EOD
- Sync w/ SRE about canary infra and scaling policies (15:30)
- Customer beta invite follow-up: send updated notes to CS and legal
- Prep launch checklist for PM review meeting tomorrow

Morning notes / quick brain dump:
- PRD: added section for latency SLOs but need concrete numbers. Current draft says: "p95 < 300ms, p99 < 800ms" — check with infra/SRE whether these are realistic for dedicated vs hosted. Add separate SLOs per deployment mode.
- Rollout plan: canary > 10% for 24h > 50% 48h > 100% — need to include automatic rollback triggers (error rate > 2% or latency regression > 30%). Ask Jordan to add metric IDs.
- Evals: tie evaluation set results to rollout gating. If new model shows >1% drop in QA on critical prompts, block rollout. Add this to PRD gating section.

To-dos (quick checklist):
- [ ] Update PRD metrics table with infra-provided baseline numbers (owner: Jordan)
- [ ] Add legal + privacy acceptance note for customer data handling in beta (owner: Priya)
- [x] Merge basic release notes draft into docs repo (done this morning)
- [ ] Draft email for beta customers with opt-out and feedback form (owner: me)
- [ ] Confirm canary instance size with infra (owner: Eli)

Meetings / follow-ups:
- 09:30 - Standup (blocked by SRE scaling question)
- 11:00 - Sync w/ CS on beta invite list (action: include product usage checklist)
- 15:30 - Infra/SRE (canary infra + autoscale) — prep questions:
   * baseline p95/p99 numbers per model type
   * how KV cache warm-up will affect first-minute latency
   * autoscale cooldown and burst capacity options for canary
- 16:30 - Quick PRD review with Jordan

Launch checklist (working; keep short):
- Infrastructure
  - Provision canary pool (GPU types + counts) — owner: Eli
  - Confirm autoscale policy and burst capacity — owner: Eli
  - Smoke test script (token-level latency + error rate) — owner: SRE
- Product/PRD
  - Metrics & gating defined in PRD — owner: Jordan
  - Rollout policy doc in repo — owner: me
- Docs/Support
  - User-facing release notes + migration notes — owner: docs
  - CS playbook for beta feedback triage — owner: CS (Priya)
- Legal/Compliance
  - Data handling sign-off for beta — owner: Legal (Priya)
notes_summary: PRD edits: finalize metrics & rollouts; coordinate with SRE on p95/p99 and autoscale; prepare launch checklist and beta communications; blockers: need infra numbers and legal sign-off
